notes.title: VOTES Section Updated!
notes.notes:
We’ve reviewed user requests and updated the Votes section with several new models — cast your vote and help us choose what to build next!

• FN M1900 (Belgium)
Designed by legendary arms maker John Browning, the FN M1900 was one of the first mass-produced semi-automatic pistols. It saw wide use in the early 20th century and was especially popular in Europe and Asia.

• Uru Submachine Gun (Brazil)
Developed in the 1970s by Mekanika Industria e Comercio, the Uru was designed for Brazilian police and military forces. Known for its simple design and ease of manufacture.

• Madsen M-50 (Denmark)
This compact submachine gun was developed after WWII and used by various military and police forces around the world, including in Latin America and Asia. It features a unique folding stock and side-mounted magazine.

• USFA ZiP .22 (USA)
One of the most unconventional firearm designs of the 21st century. Manufactured by US Fire Arms Manufacturing Company, the ZiP .22 aimed to be a modular, affordable plinker — but gained notoriety for its reliability issues and was discontinued shortly after release.

notes.title: HK G11 is now available in World of Guns!

HK G11 is now available in World of Guns!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/97da0b9f9d2f26581802745e5b111f41345e72ae.jpg[/img]

Today is a special day for the entire World of Guns project—we are releasing the most highly requested model ever!

Recreating the HK G11 took more than half a year, and we hope you'll enjoy exploring its intricate design. With over 240 parts and a highly complex firing mechanism, this model is truly unique.

To help you understand how it works, we’ll be hosting several live streams to explain its mechanics in detail.
What makes this model special:

🔹 Disassembly/Assembly – 248 parts
🔹 Operation features:

    Fire, Burst Fire, Full Auto Fire, Reload, Safety (detailed animations)
    HD textures
    Flying bullets and realistic gas operation

Promo Code – Get the HK G11 for Free!

The first 50 users can unlock the HK G11 for free using this promo code:
FCM5
How to redeem the promo code:

    Run the game and go to the main menu.
    Open the console by pressing ~ (Tilde).
    Type: promo <code> (use CAPS LOCK).
    Press Enter.
        Example: promo FCM5
        Note: The console key may vary depending on your language settings.
        The promo code must be entered in the main menu!

🔹 Want more exclusive content? Check out our [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/WorldOfGuns]Patreon [/url]for additional materials!

notes.title: Clockwork Basilisk book has been released
notes.notes:
World of Guns worked closely together with Ben Nicholson to create the 1818 Collier Flintlock Revolver. Headstamp Publishing is producing his book Clockwork Basilisk: The Early Revolvers of Elisha Collier and Artemas Wheeler. [url=https://www.headstamppublishing.com/purchase/p/basilisk-standard]The book[/url] has been already released including World of Guns participation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/f1f05a2b3c1d2839c8cc70ee167cd7c248a3423e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.headstamppublishing.com/purchase/p/basilisk-standard]Check it![/url]

World of Guns and a dream-team of Collier scholars spent thousands of hours recreating this historic revolver, and a whole chapter in the book describes the close process of our work together!

notes.title: Server works and account issues
notes.notes:
Dear World of Guns users,
last week our hosting provider had an accident. Our main server was down and we worked all week on a backup server.
Today we restored all our servers and now all services should work normally.
However we suppose that some users may face issues with lost progress, credits, purchases etc.
Please, feel free to contact us using our support email or Discord.
We will fix all issues personally.
Also users which used Facebook login should contact us and we will help restore their accounts.

Email:  support@noble-empire.com
or
[url=https://discord.gg/KXhAmGWSdG]Discord[/url] channel

Thank you for understanding!
NE support team

notes.title: Latest news
notes.notes:
Dear Users!
We would like to clarify the situation!
1. The original eu1 server is still  unreachable and we work on a backup version.
2. The eu2 version went back online yesterday and a lot of users restored their progress on Steam, Android and iOs.
3. We just released the x64 version of World of Guns, it should fix some small issues with performance, overheating PC etc.
4. For those who lost their progress!
Don't panic, we have backup by 21 of March.
We just want to wait till eu1 will be restored completely and then we will resolve all issues with lost progress, purchases  etc. We will do announcement inside the app in the News section!

We apologize for such a situation and we do our best!
NE

notes.title: The Early Revolvers of Elisha Collier and Artemas Wheeler
notes.notes:
World of Guns worked closely together with Ben Nicholson to create the 1818 Collier Flintlock Revolver. Headstamp Publishing is producing his book Clockwork Basilisk: The Early Revolvers of Elisha Collier and Artemas Wheeler and have just launched a Kickstarter Campaign for its release, that will include World of Guns participation in the future.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/headstamp/clockwork-basilisk?ref=b3tdga]Check it![/url]

World of Guns and a dream-team of Collier scholars spent thousands of hours recreating this historic revolver, and a whole chapter in the book describes the close process of our work together!

The Berdan rifle is a Russian rifle created by the American firearms expert and inventor Hiram Berdan in 1868. It was standard issue in the Russian army from 1870 to 1891, when it was replaced by the Mosin–Nagant rifle. It was widely used in Russia as a hunting weapon, and sporting variants, including shotguns, were produced until the mid-1930s.

The Russian Berdan I (M1868) and Berdan II (M1870) rifles of .42 caliber are distinct from the Spanish Berdan 15mm (.58+ cal) conversion rifles adopted by Spain as the M1857/67 Berdan (and related engineer, artillery & short rifles).

notes.title: New model goes to production: PB silent pistol
notes.notes:
[img]https://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/pb_silent_large.jpg[/img]

The leader of the voting for the last 15 days is PB silent pistol.

The PB uses an integral suppressor, which, unlike most similar systems, consists of two parts. This allows the pistol to be carried and kept concealed without the front section of the suppressor attached, and for the suppressor to be quickly deployed prior to use.

[url=https://modernfirearms.net/en/handguns/handguns-en/russia-semi-automatic-pistols/pb-besshumnyj-eng/]More on modernfirarms.net>>[/url]  

We take it into production.
NE team

notes.title: New model goes to production: ZfK-55
notes.notes:
Победитель голосования за последние 15 дней -  снайперская винтовка ZfK-55.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/zfk_55_n_large.jpg[/img]
Впервые принятые на вооружение в 1889 году 7.5мм винтовки были модифицированы в 1911 году в связи с введением модифицированного патрона 7.5mm Gewehrpatrone 11 (7.5×55 GP11). Однако, к началу 1930х годов винтовки и карабины образца 1911 года перестали удовлетворять текущим требованиям, и в 1932 году парламент Швейцарии одобрил создание новой унифицированной короткой винтовки (карабина). Летом 1933 года новый карабин был принят на вооружение Швейцарской армии под обозначением К31 (от Karabiner 31, карабин обр. 1931 года). Карабин K31 базировался на модифицированной конструкции затвора прямого действия системы Шмидта, однако затвор и ствольная коробка были изрядно укорочены за счет переноса боевых упоров с середины затвора в его переднюю часть. Производство карабинов K31 продолжалось с 1933 по 1958 год, их общий выпуск превысил 500 000 штук. В 1955 году на основе K31 была создана снайперская винтовка K31-55, также известная под обозначением ZfK-55.
[url=http://modernfirearms.net/ru/vintovki/magazinnye-vintovki/shvejcarija-magazinnye-vintovki/k31//]Инфо на modernfirearms>[/url]

Мы берем его в работу.

Команда NE

notes.title: New model request: HK VP9
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Heckler & Koch VP9' semi-automatic pistol.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/hk_vp9_large.jpg[/img]
The Heckler & Koch VP9 is a polymer-framed semi-automatic striker-fired handgun. The VP stands for Volkspistole which translates to "people's pistol". The 9 stands for the caliber designation of 9mm. The VP9 is the 3rd striker-fired pistol that HK has produced. It is known under the designation SFP9 in Europe and Canada.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heckler_%26_Koch_VP9]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: HK416
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Heckler & Koch HK416' assault rifle/carbine.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/hk_416_large.jpg[/img]
The Heckler & Koch HK416 is an assault rifle/carbine designed and manufactured by Heckler & Koch. Although its design is in large part based on the AR-15 class of weapons, specifically the Colt M4 carbine family issued to the U.S. military, it uses an HK-proprietary short-stroke gas piston system originally derived from the ArmaLite AR-18 (the same system was also used in Heckler & Koch's earlier G36 family of rifles). The HK416 gained fame as the weapon that United States Navy SEALs from DEVGRU Red Squadron used to kill Osama Bin Laden in 2011.
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heckler_%26_Koch_HK416]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: Frommer Stop
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Frommer Stop' pistol.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/frommer_stop_large.jpg[/img]
The Frommer Stop is a Hungarian long-recoil pistol manufactured by Fémáru-, Fegyver és Gépgyár (FÉG) (Metalware, Weapons and Machine Factory) in Budapest. It was designed by Rudolf Frommer, and its original design was adopted as the Pisztoly 12M in 1912, created for the Royal Hungarian Army. The handgun was manufactured in various forms from 1912 to 1945 and used in the Hungarian Armed Forces. The Stop is 165 millimeters (6.5 in) long with a 95 millimeters (3.7 in) 4-groove rifled barrel. Unloaded weight is 610 g (22 oz), and the detachable box magazine holds seven rounds.
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frommer_Stop]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: Suomi M/31
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Suomi M/31' submachine gun.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/suomi_m31_large.jpg[/img]
The Suomi M/31 (KP/-31, Suomi-konepistooli or "Submachine-gun Finland", literally: "Machine-pistol Finland") was a submachine gun (SMG) of Finnish design used during World War II. It was a descendant of the M-22 prototype and the KP/-26 production model, which was revealed to the public in 1925. 

The Suomi KP/-31 went into serial production in 1931 by Tikkakoski Oy and most of these weapons were bought by the Finnish Defence Forces. The Finnish Defence Forces were equipped with about 4000 Suomi KP/-31 submachine guns when the Winter War started.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suomi_KP/-31]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: Walther MPL
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Walther MPL' submachine gun.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/walther_mpl_large.jpg[/img]
There are two versions of the Walther MP: the MPK (Maschinenpistole Kurz or "short machine pistol") and the MPL (Maschinenpistole Lang or "long machine pistol"). A selective fire switch is also on both the left and right side of the receiver, behind the trigger, allowing for ambidextrous use.

Both guns feature side-folding buttstocks, made from thin steel tubes, and both guns feature flip-up sights. The MPL has 100 and 200 meter settings.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walther_MP]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

[img]https://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/beretta_arx_160_large.jpg[/img]
The Beretta ARX160 is an Italian modular assault rifle manufactured by Beretta. [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beretta_ARX160]More on Wikipedia >>[/url] 

We take it in production.
NE team

notes.title: New model request: HK P9s pistol
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'HK P9s' pistol.

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/hk_p9s_large.jpg[/img]

The HK P9 is a semi-automatic pistol from Heckler & Koch in 9×19mm Parabellum and the first to use a variation of H&K's roller delayed blowback system in a pistol format and polygonal rifling now common in H&K designs. Design began around 1965 and production ran between 1969 and 1978. Only 485 single-action P9's were produced and were discontinued in 1970.[citation needed] A traditional double action version, the P9S (the S standing for Spannabzug, or "double-action trigger") was manufactured in greater numbers.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heckler_%26_Koch_P9]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: Lebel Model 1886 rifle
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Lebel Model 1886 rifle'. 

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/lebel_1886_large.jpg[/img]

The Lebel Model 1886 rifle is also known as the "Fusil Mle 1886 M93", after a bolt modification was added in 1893. It is an 8 mm bolt action infantry rifle that entered service in the French Army in 1887. It is a repeating rifle that can hold eight rounds in its forestock tube magazine, one round in the transporter plus one round in the chamber. The Lebel rifle has the distinction of being the first military firearm to use smokeless powder ammunition.

notes.title: New model request: Gewehr 1888
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Gewehr 1888'  bolt action rifle. (commonly called the Model 1888 commission rifle)

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/gewehr_88_large.jpg[/img]

The invention of smokeless powder in the late 19th century immediately rendered all of the large-bore black powder rifles then in use obsolete. To keep pace with the French (who had adopted smokeless powder "small bore" ammunition for their Lebel Model 1886 rifle) the Germans adopted the Gewehr 88 using its own new M/88 cartridge, which was also designed by the German Rifle Commission.[9] The rifle was one of many weapons in the arms race between the Germanic states and France, and with Europe in general. There were also two carbine versions, the Karabiner 88 for mounted troops and the Gewehr 91 for artillery. 

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gewehr_1888]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model goes to production: M249 SAW
notes.notes:
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/m249_saw_large.jpg[/img]

Leader of the voting for the last 15 days is the M249 light machine gun.

It is the American adaptation of the Belgian FN Minimi, a light machine gun manufactured by the Belgian company FN Herstal (FN). The M249 is manufactured in the United States by the local subsidiary FN Manufacturing LLC in South Carolina and is widely used in the U.S. Armed Forces. The weapon was introduced in 1984 after being judged the most effective of a number of candidate weapons to address the lack of automatic firepower in small units. The M249 provides infantry squads with the high rate of fire of a machine gun combined with accuracy and portability approaching that of a rifle.

We take it in production.

NE team

notes.title: New model request: Cz Scorpion EVO 3 A1
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Cz Scorpion EVO 3 A1'  submachine gun.

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/cz_scorpion_evo3_a1_large.jpg[/img]

The Skorpion Evo 3 evolved from a Slovak prototype submachine gun called the Laugo. Chambered in 9×19mm Parabellum, the Scorpion EVO 3 is a lightweight, compact submachine gun designed to be easily maneuvered in constrained spaces. The A1 variant features a select fire switch, giving the operator the choice of "safe", semi-automatic, three-round burst, or fully automatic fire, while the S1's switch only features "safe" and semi-automatic fire. The standard version comes equipped with a folding, adjustable and fully removable stock for easy transport. The hand guard is lined with multiple Picatinny rails for the addition of attachments such as grips, sights, flashlights, and lasers.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CZ_Scorpion_Evo_3]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: M1941 Johnson rifle
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'M1941 Johnson' rifle.

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/johnson_m1941_large.jpg[/img]

The M1941 Johnson Rifle was an American short-recoil operated semi-automatic rifle designed by Melvin Johnson prior to World War II. The M1941 competed unsuccessfully with the U.S. M1 Rifle.
The M1941 rifle used the energy from recoil to operate the rifle. As the bullet and propellant gases moved down the barrel, they imparted a force on the bolt head that was locked to the barrel. The barrel, together with the bolt, moved a short distance rearward until the bullet left the barrel and pressure in the bore had dropped to safe levels. 

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M1941_Johnson_rifle]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/gewehr_43_large.jpg[/img]

The Gewehr 43 or Karabiner 43 (abbreviated G43, K43, Gew 43, Kar 43) is a 7.92×57mm Mauser caliber semi-automatic rifle developed by Germany during World War II. The design was based on that of the earlier G41(W), but incorporating an improved short-stroke piston gas system similar to that of the Soviet Tokarev SVT-40, and it incorporated innovative mass-production techniques.

'SD card' icon - means that current model has been downloaded and can be used in off-line mode.

notes.title: Victory day!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the victory over Nazi Germany during World War II, we've unlocked 27 models from the USSR, Germany, USA, Great Britain, France and Japan for a limited time!

In this time you can play, explore and earn exp. points and credits.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New model request: Fedorov Avtomat
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Fedorov Avtomat'  automatic rifle.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/fedorov_avtomat_large.jpg[/img]
The Fedorov Avtomat was an automatic rifle, designed by Vladimir Grigoryevich Fyodorov in 1915 and produced in the Russian Empire and later in the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. A total of 43,200 Fedorov rifles were manufactured between 1915 and 1924 in the city of Kovrov; the vast majority of them were made after 1920. The weapon saw combat in World War I, but was used more substantially in the Russian Civil War and in the 1939–1940 Soviet-Finnish war.
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedorov_Avtomat]More on Wikipedia >>[/url]

notes.title: World of Guns: Gun Disassembly recent update
notes.notes:
We've made an update several days ago and it worth to tell more about it.

What we've been doing over the last few months:
- UI improvement in game modes: disassembly/assembly progress indicator (green line under model name) - it helps a lot when the part flies out of the field of view during animation, or when a user has doubts if the part has finished its animation or not)
- UI improvement in game modes: during disassembly/assembly animation parts are highlighted with orange shading (no pulsation) - very helpful in hardcore mode
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/animation_ui.jpg[/img]
- 10 music albums have been added
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/music_alb.jpg[/img]
- Slovak localization added (work in progress)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/sk_lang.jpg[/img]
- All localizations are updated (Chinese [traditional], Polish and Swedish are still in progress)
- UI improvement (Animation Speed-Up On/Off icon, Autofocus On/Off icon have been added to Game mode)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/anim_on.jpg[/img]
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/autofocus_on.jpg[/img]
- Daily puzzle updated (we added the possibility to gain +1 life for 10 right answers in a row)
- Multi-platform mechanism added. You may merge accounts from Facebook, Android, stand alone version, etc. ( in the game go to Account, Manage Account-Merge Accounts)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/accounts_merge.jpg[/img]
- HD textures for models announced (check progress on the community forum)
- DEMO modes have been added (Game Demo, Super Game Demo, Hardcore Demo and Cinematic demo(circled playing of all unlocked models one by one))
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/cinematic_demo.jpg[/img]
 - Optimization and bug fixes

Thank you for your support!

NE team

notes.title: The bug in the Competitve Rank Leaderboard has now been fixed!
notes.notes:
The bug in the Competitve Rank Leaderboard has now been fixed!
If you checked several days ago, you would have noticed that the results had changed.
The leaderboard had experienced a bug, during which time all high score positions had been included in the rank calculations.
This was wrong- only the high score was supposed to be counted.
Now the leaderboard works correctly and we check it regularly to ensure the scores are accurate.
The Competitive Rank results are also now recalculated once every hour.

We would also like to mention that World of Guns is a multi-platform game.
You can play it on Steam, Facebook, Android (+iOS soon) and on our standalone version with the same account.
For your Score Total it makes no difference, as there is no change in how you earn points.
For Competitive Ranking it is a completly different matter.
Steam scores are generally higher than those achieved through the Facebook platform and this is why we won't include TOP 100 high-scores earnt on Facebook on other platforms.
(When you switch from Facebook your Competitive Rank will be 0 on the new platform until you earn new high-scores)

notes.title: World of Guns competition! Saturday! 17:30 (time zone +UTC 00:00)
notes.notes:
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/champ_tec_large.jpg[/img]


We will be LIVE on TWITCH https://www.twitch.tv/ler_wog
What we have in plans:
17:30-18:00 Guns comparison (AK with StG 44, Colt M1911 vs Tokarev pistol)
18:00 -18:30 Warm up
18:30 - 19:00 Competition - Model TEC-9

Championship rules!
Start time 18:30, 8 of the April, Saturday (time zone +UTC 00:00)
1. The Championship is only for Steam users (so we will check the Steam users high scores table)
2. The model of the week is the TEC-9 - That means that we will only count all high scores for this model.
3. The contest will start at 18:30 and will be finished at 19:00 (Saturday UTC  +UTC+00:00).
4. For 30 mins participants have to gain the best high score for the Game, Super Game and Hardcore Game modes (if high score did not pass verification by the server it will not be counted).
5. The winner is the person who has the highest combined points total across all 3 Game modes (for example, Game: 300 000, Super Game:200 000 Hardcore:220 000 - the combined sum is 720 000 points)
6. The prize for the first place - 10 credits, for second place - 5 credits, for third place - 3 credits
7. The championship will be LIVE on the Twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/ler_wog
8. The winners will be announced within 10 mins after 19:00.
9. Results will be posted on the correspondent community [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/262410/discussions/0/135513549095714213/] thread [/url]

notes.title: New model request: S&W 5906 pistol
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'S&W 5906' pistol.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/sw_5906_large.jpg[/img]

The 5906 is a full-sized, double/single-action, staggered-column magazine, 9x19mm pistol. Its construction is all stainless steel. The 5906 is equipped with a magazine disconnect feature which is designed to deactivate the trigger if the magazine is not fully inserted. The pistol comes standard with either a 10- or 15-round magazine. Other features include ambidextrous safety levers, a one-piece rear wraparound grip, and a choice of either fixed sights or a rear sight fully adjustable for windage and elevation. A popular model with law enforcement and military units in the United States, the 5906 is nevertheless being replaced by lighter, polymer-framed models from Glock, Heckler & Koch, SIG Sauer as well as Smith & Wesson's own M&P line of polymer framed handguns in both 9mm and .40 calibers.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smith_%26_Wesson_Model_5906] More on Wikipedia >> [/url]

notes.title: New mode request: M249 SAW
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'M249 SAW'.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/m249_saw_large.jpg[/img]

The M249 light machine gun (LMG), formerly designated the M249 Squad Automatic Weapon (SAW), and formally written as Light Machine Gun, 5.56 mm, or the .223 military rnd. The M249, is the American adaptation of the Belgian FN Minimi, a light machine gun manufactured by the Belgian company FN Herstal (FN). The M249 is manufactured in the United States by the local subsidiary FN Manufacturing LLC in South Carolina and is widely used in the U.S. Armed Forces. The weapon was introduced in 1984 after being judged the most effective of a number of candidate weapons to address the lack of automatic firepower in small units. The M249 provides infantry squads with the heavy volume of fire of a machine gun combined with accuracy and portability approaching that of a rifle.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M249_light_machine_gun/] More on Wikipedia >> [/url]

notes.title: New model request: 'Hotchkiss Portative LMG'
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'Hotchkiss Portative LMG'.

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/hotchkiss_portative_large.jpg[/img]

The Hotchkiss Portative was a variant of the Hotchkiss medium machine gun designed for use in the LMG role. It used the same long-stroke gas system and interrupted-thread locking system as the earlier Hotchkiss, but had the feed system inverted to save space and the gun significantly lightened. Developed in 1907, it was one of the early light machine guns available on the market, and purchased by several countries. They were used by the US (in .30-06, designated the M1909 Benet-Mercie), Great Britain, Belgium, Sweden, Mexico, and others.
[url=http://www.forgottenweapons.com/light-machine-guns/hotchkiss-portative-lmg/] More on Forgotten Weapons [/url]

1. We updated geometry of the most parts 
2. We added some missing parts (springs, pins etc) 
3. We added cutaway and flying bullet
4. We added texture for upper receiver and magazines and updated texture for the lower receiver
5. Safety feature has been added
6. Wallpaper has been added.

It seems there is no reason to give away promocode beause
a) this model can be choosen as a start model
b) anyway it can be opened very fast (it is the third model after AK in the spider menu)

Hope you will like the update.
NE team

notes.title: FG-42 goes to the production !
notes.notes:
Leader of the voting for the last month is FG-42
We take it in production.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/fg_42_large.jpg[/img]

[i]The FG 42 is a selective-fire automatic rifle or battle rifle produced in Nazi Germany during World War II. The weapon was developed specifically for the use of the Fallschirmjäger airborne infantry in 1942 and was used in very limited numbers until the end of the war.

It combined the characteristics and firepower of a light machine gun in a lightweight form no larger than the standard-issue Kar 98k bolt-action rifle. Considered one of the most advanced weapon designs of World War II, the FG 42 influenced post-war small arms development, and most of its design was copied by the US Army when they developed the M60 machine gun.[/i] [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FG_42]Read more...[/url] 
Thank you for support and don't forget to VOTE for the next model, which will be taken in production next month.

NE team

notes.title: New features!
notes.notes:
Some new features have been released for WoG in the past week!
- From now on, users may choose the model that they begin the game with or after a progress reset. Before, it was only the AK-47 without choice, but for some users the AK was very hard, so now you may choose one of 6 models to start with.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/start_models.jpg[/img]
- Some of the players used the pause button - clicking it every step of the disassembly - in order to gain the best high score. We think such an activity is not appropriate and so we decided to prohibit it.
The issue was that with constant use of the pause button to cheat we couldn't track cheaters. Now we have changed the way that the pause button works, but old high scores can still be found under the tab "Old*" in the High Scores table.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/old_scores.jpg[/img]
- A new kind of rank table has been released. It shows the current total score for each Top 100 All-Time scores/times achieved for all of the competitive game modes (Game, Super Game, Hardcore & Shooting Ranges).
To find it, please go to Charts and choose the Competitive Rank in the upper middle of the screen, and you will also find a description of how it works.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/new_rank.jpg[/img]
NE team

Please, vote for it in the game if you like it and want to see it soon in the World of Guns

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/madsen_large.jpg[/img]

The Madsen was a light machine gun that Julius A. Rasmussen and Theodor Schoubue designed and proposed for adoption by Captain Vilhelm Herman Oluf Madsen, the Danish Minister of War, and that the Danish Army adopted in 1902. It was the world's first true light machine gun produced in quantity. Consequently, Madsen was able to sell it in 12 different calibres to over 34 different countries worldwide, where it saw extensive combat for over 100 years. The Madsen was produced by Compagnie Madsen A/S (later operating as Dansk Rekyl Riffel Syndikat A/S and then Dansk Industri Syndikat A/S).

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madsen_machine_gun]More on Wikipedia>>[/url]

notes.title: New model request: FN F2000
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'FN F2000' bullpup assault rifle.
Please, vote for it in the game if you like it and want to see it soon in the World of Guns

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/fn_f2000_large.jpg[/img]

The FN F2000 is a 5.56x45mm NATO bullpup assault rifle, designed by FN Herstal in Belgium. The F2000 is a modular weapon system; its principal component is a compact 5.56x45mm NATO-caliber assault rifle configured in a bullpup layout. The F2000 is a selective fire weapon operating from a closed bolt.

The rifle consists of two main assemblies: the barreled receiver group and the frame, coupled together by means of an axis pin located above the trigger guard. The barrel group has an integral MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny rail used to mount optical sights. The frame or lower receiver contains the trigger group, the bolt and bolt carrier assembly, return mechanism and magazine well. A removable handguard is installed in front of the trigger which completes and encloses the trigger guard.
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FN_F2000]More on Wikipedia>>[/url]

notes.title: New mode request: PKM machine gun
notes.notes:
New model has been requested by our user: 'PKM' machine gun.
Please, vote for it in the game if you like it and want to see it soon in the World of Guns

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/pkm_large.jpg[/img]

The PKM ("Kalashnikov's Machine-gun Modernized"), was adopted into service in 1969. The PKM is a modernized, product-improved version of the PK. The upgrades, primarily aimed at reducing the weight, simplifying production, and facilitating easier operation.

 The receiver cover became more rigid due to lengthwise ribs. The butt was fitted with a hinged butt-rest. The barrel fluting was omitted and the flash hider was changed. Later on the PKM was equipped with a new black glass-filled polyamide buttstock and pistol grip shaped like the previously used laminated wooden stock and grip..
[url=http://www.forgottenweapons.com/medium-machine-guns/pk-pkm/]More on Forgotten Weapons>>[/url]

notes.title: New Model Request: Henry Lever Action Octagon Rifle - Frontier Model
notes.notes:
[h1]New model has been requested by our user: 'Henry Lever Action Octagon Rifle - Frontier Model'.[/h1]
You may support it by voting in game!
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/henry_large.jpg[/img]
Henry's popular lever-action rifle line continues with this octagon barrel Frontier model. This rifle's features include the prominent octagon barrel, a Marble's fully adjustable rear sight and a raised blade front sight. The octagon barrel is designed to help repel heat and reduce the barrel temperature after repeated shooting. The steel barrel and action are blued. A metal barrel band secures the barrel to walnut forend. This Henry rifle also has a hand finished walnut stock and the top of the action is grooved to add a riflescope. An icon of the West that will find favor with many shooters and collectors. 
[url=https://www.henryrifles.com/rifles/lever-octagon-frontier-rifle/]More on henryrifles.com>[/url]

notes.title: WoG: New Model Request: ZfK 55
notes.notes:
[h1]New model was requested by our user: 'ZfK 55 sniper rifle'.[/h1]
The rifle is basically a K31 action, with a bunch of modifications to convert it into a very nice marksman’s rifle. The more obvious changes are the muzzle brake (very reminiscent of the second model FG-42, which makes sense as the Swiss experimented with those rifles quite a bit after the war), pistol grip stock, bipod, and 3.5x optical scope.
[url=http://www.forgottenweapons.com/sniper-rifles/swiss-zfk-55/]More on Forgotten Weapons>[/url] 
You can vote for the model in the game, in Company>Votes

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/zfk_55_small.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WoG: New Features!
notes.notes:
[h1]New features have been added to WoG![/h1]
Now you may  download all available models for you with one click!
Go to Catalog. In the left bottom corner press [b] 'Precache Unlocked Models' [/b]

Another feature -[b] 'Favorites'[/b]
Now you may add to 'Favorites' list any model and then have fast access from the Catalog - Favorites.
How it works!
Go to model menu and near the achievements press Star! That's it!
Mark all your favorites models. Go to Catalog - Favorites to get fast access to models.

Hope you'll like new features!
NE team

[img]http://noble-empire.com/images/news/favorites.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WoG new feature - voting for upcoming models!
notes.notes:
Meet new feature in WoG - voting for upcoming models!

The most popular threads in the community are about upcoming models. So we decided to make poll for upcoming models. Button for the poll can be found in the top left corner of the main menu under the Daily Champions button.
[img]http://noble-empire.com/images/news/buttons.jpg[/img]

We made a list of the most requested models and now you may vote one time using the exp points and unlimited times using credits to support the model you want to be done. We will wait for several months and then choose the model for development. If you will spend 10 or more credits you'll get the model automatically after release.
  Also you may request model for 1000 Credits. If we will be able to create such model, it will go to the vote list. If model will receive enough votes we will take it in the development. We may discuss development process, let you test the model and so on.
[img]http://noble-empire.com/images/news/poll_large.jpg[/img]

[table][*]we deleted all hi scores under the Top 1000

Let's make fair play!

NE dev team

P.S. Don't forget we always work on this project. 
We already working more the 6 years with it, and hope we will go further!

notes.title: One year summary!
notes.notes:
[h1]What we've done for one year on Steam![/h1]
[b]New models![/b]
- 17 new weapon models released (Colt Walker, AKS 74U, SPAS-12, Liberator, Browning A-5, Winchester Model 21, HK USP, Nagant M1895, Browning M2, FN 57, BT MP9, Walther P99, M79, VSS Vintorez, APS, AS Val, L86 A2
- 3 car models released (IFV BMP-3, HMMWV A2, DeLorean)

[b]New features![/b]
- Trading cards has been added.
- Workshop support
- Hardcore Game
- Paint Mode
- Special operation, quiz and booster have been added.

[b]Engine Improvements[/b]
-WASD camer control support
-Music and sound control
-Mouse sensitivity control
-Pause/rewind animation (in operate mode)
-Click'n Hide feature (operate mode)
-Interface performance x2
-Catalog search improvement
-Demonstration of operated gases and flying bullet
-Auto fire true animation system has been improved (operate mode)
-Single action and double action mechanism added (now works on HK USP, -APS)
-New achievement - serenity (game modes)

[b]Visual improvements[/b]
-Antialiasing
-Loading art has been added
-7 additional backgrounds

[b]Misc[/b]
-Different DLCs have been released (Lifetime Access, 4 sport cars, 5 skeletons, 10 shooting range, Starter pack, WWII)
-11 languages for interface have been added: Spain, Chinese, Czech, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Sweden, Russian, Ukrainian
- Mac and Linux support

We listen to our users and try to make our World of Guns better!
See you in the community!

Dev Team
